course_name: 人工智慧導論與程式語言
outline: 本課程將做為大一學生入學後第一門程式語言奠基課程，作為程式設計的基礎。教授內容包括電腦運作概念、程式設計原則、分支敘述、迴圈敘述、輸出、輸入敘述、陣列處理、字元處理、及子程式等課題。本課程並介紹 AI 基本原理與程式應用。
schedule:
Week 1: Introduction to Computers and Programming. Assignment:
Week 2: Typing / Spreadsheet  formula, matrix multiplication and inversion  (class time to move to week 3 or 4, to be scheduled in week 1)
Week 3: Spreadsheet formula: min, round, sqrt, if, countif, match, index and VBA basics
Week 4: Variables and mathematical formula
Week 5: Branching Statements
Week 6: Loop
Week 7: Array / Vector / Matrix
Week 8: Midterm
Week 9: Programming on mathematical formula (I)
Week 10: Programming on mathematical formula (II)
Week 11: Programming on Branching and Loop (I)
Week 12: Programming on Branching and Loop (II)
Week 13: Programming on Branching and Loop (III)
Week 14: Programming on Functions and Subroutines (I)
Week 15: Programming on Functions and Subroutines (II)
Week 16: Final exam.
Week 17: Advanced topics 1 online
Week 18: Advanced topics 2 online
